proof_body:
by
  intro a b c x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ x₃ y₃ s t u hs ht hu hsum
  have h₁ : a * x₁ + b * y₁ + c ≤ max (max (a * x₁ + b * y₁ + c) (a * x₂ + b * y₂ + c)) (a * x₃ + b * y₃ + c) := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
  have h₂ : a * x₂ + b * y₂ + c ≤ max (max (a * x₁ + b * y₁ + c) (a * x₂ + b * y₂ + c)) (a * x₃ + b * y₃ + c) := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
  have h₃ : a * x₃ + b * y₃ + c ≤ max (max (a * x₁ + b * y₁ + c) (a * x₂ + b * y₂ + c)) (a * x₃ + b * y₃ + c) := le_max_right _ _
  generalize max (max (a * x₁ + b * y₁ + c) (a * x₂ + b * y₂ + c)) (a * x₃ + b * y₃ + c) = M at *
  have e : a * (s * x₁ + t * x₂ + u * x₃) + b * (s * y₁ + t * y₂ + u * y₃) + c = s * (a * x₁ + b * y₁ + c) + t * (a * x₂ + b * y₂ + c) + u * (a * x₃ + b * y₃ + c) := by
    linear_combination (-c) * hsum
  have e₂ : M = s * M + t * M + u * M := by linear_combination (-M) * hsum
  rw [e, e₂]
  exact add_le_add (add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h₁ hs) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h₂ ht)) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h₃ hu)
target_source: ∀ (a b c x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ x₃ y₃ s t u : ℝ), 0 ≤ s → 0 ≤ t → 0 ≤ u → s + t + u = 1 → a * (s * x₁ + t * x₂ + u * x₃) + b * (s * y₁ + t * y₂ + u * y₃) + c ≤ max (max (a * x₁ + b * y₁ + c) (a * x₂ + b * y₂ + c)) (a * x₃ + b * y₃ + c)
